mostly minor flooding on the White River, and minor flooding on the

flooding is at Spencer on the White River in Owen County, where the
river crest is currently located.

eastern Warren County eastward to Madison County.  The heaviest
rainfall fell in the Shadeland area of southwest Tippecanoe County,
slightly lesser amounts north-northwest of Frankfort in Clinton
County and just southwest of Frankton in Madison County.  Showers
and thunderstorms are expected to continue through the night, slowly
dropping south with time.
